description: Provision a Google Cloud Edgenetwork EdgeNetworkSubnet via Config Connector. Fields mirror the edgenetwork.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 EdgeNetworkSubnet spec.

description.description: Immutable. A free-text description of the resource. Max length 1024 characters.

ipv4Cidr.description: Immutable. The ranges of ipv4 addresses that are owned by this subnetwork, in CIDR format.

ipv6Cidr.description: Immutable. The ranges of ipv6 addresses that are owned by this subnetwork, in CIDR format.

location.description: Immutable. The Google Cloud region to which the target Distributed Cloud Edge zone belongs.

networkRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of an `EdgeNetworkNetwork` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The subnetId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

vlanId.description: Immutable. VLAN ID for this subnetwork. If not specified, one is assigned automatically.

zone.description: Immutable. The name of the target Distributed Cloud Edge zone.
